label: Columns of runs.csv and dialogs.csv written by export_csv_v4.py (experiments A and B, AUDIT.md section 16). Evaluation only.
declared: 2026-11-13, before the exporter existed. The first columns of each table are the faculty plan's list in its order; the rest are extras. To match the faculty's own column list later, edit this file only: reorder, delete, or give a column another header ('header'); the 'field' names are the exporter's (export_csv_v4.RUN_FIELDS / DIALOG_FIELDS, with their definitions in export.json of every export). A field name that is not known is refused with the list of known fields.

why.order: Plan of 2026-11-13: runs.csv = experiment, set, seed, looks, route, goal, outcome, time, trail vs optimal, stops, collisions, lies given / detected / corrected / fooled; dialogs.csv = junction, worker, look, command shown, truthful, command read, correct, time to read, distance, decision. 'trail vs optimal' is three columns (trail_m, optimal_m, trail_over_optimal).
why.correct: The plan's 'correct' can mean the reader was right (command_read == command_shown) or the decision was right; the exporter gives three columns, correct (the command read is the command shown), correct_direction (the branch read is the branch shown) and correct_branch (the branch read is the true branch toward B). Keep the ones the faculty means.
why.lies: lies_given counts lying gestures in truth.jsonl; detected, corrected and fooled are defined in the docstring of export_csv_v4.py and in export.json.
